svg.title: See
svg.desc: Command: snapshot, What it does: One line per element with role, name, state, value and ref. --interactive, --scope, --max (outline characters) and --depth bound output.; Command: observe, What it does: Full observation or ordered line replacement patch with --since BASELINE; retains at most eight document-local baselines.; Command: extract <target>, What it does: Typed table/form/list data and source refs; --kind, --limit, --text-max, --schema. Check truncated.; Command: watch <target>, What it does: Event-driven DOM condition: --state, --equals, --duration (0–25 seconds); returns matched=false on expiry.; Command: capabilities, What it does: Supported observation/input paths and explicit limitations.; Command: text, What it does: The visible text, as the browser lays it out. The cheapest way to read.; Command: markdown, What it does: The page as markdown with tables and absolute links. --main drops navigation and page chrome.; Command: html, links, What it does: The live DOM; every link as text and URL, with --filter.
